name: Abánades (Spain)
description: A red hoist stripe of one third bearing the crowned municipal arms of Abánades (a tower and waves), the fly divided horizontally green over blue.
history: The flag of Abánades was approved by the regional government and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 27 January 2015; it is a rectangular cloth of 2:3 with a red vertical stripe of one third at the hoist bearing the municipal arms and a fly divided horizontally green above and blue below.

features.role: crown and tower of the arms
